Dear Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH team,

You have linked additional capacity to binding commitment; it sounds like certainty about future demand is what helps you reserve capacity. If you can secure our full requirement, we are ready to commit long-term and support predictable production planning. How can we translate that commitment into a dependable allocation covering our full requirement?

We confirm a binding volume of 23,400 units per year for 36 months. Our should-cost estimate for Mechanical seal 24 mm, SiC/carbon, EPDM is EUR 24.31 per 1 (cost:340010). Our orders for Mechanical seal 24 mm, SiC/carbon, EPDM were at EUR 28.94 until December 2023 and have been at EUR 29.89 since January 2024 (po:4500010364-10, po:4500010407-10, po:4500014436-10). Your on-time delivery over the last 12 months was 79.5% (sc:70410@2026Q3). We understand a change of this size needs your pricing committee; please put this proposal to them.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 29.57 per unit, 23,400 units a year, 36 months, 56 days lead time). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Dear Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH team,

You repeat your lead time and explicitly recognise the value of a longer commitment—it sounds like predictable capacity planning is central for you. We are ready to support that planning with a firm long-term commitment, provided our full requirement is secured. How can we translate that certainty into a firm allocation that works for both of us?

We confirm a binding volume of 23,400 units per year for 36 months. Labour cost index DE, manufacturing, seasonally and calendar adjusted (quarterly, carried to its three months) changed -0.3% from 2025-10 to 2026-01 (idx:LCI-C@2025-10, idx:LCI-C@2026-01). Producer prices DE: other rubber products changed -0.3% from 2026-01 to 2026-02 (idx:PPI-C2219@2026-01, idx:PPI-C2219@2026-02).

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 29.94 per unit, 23,400 units a year, 36 months, 56 days lead time). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke
